questions.question: In head-to-head T20 meetings, who has the edge, Rhinos or Tuskers?
Which bowler holds the second-most 5-wicket hauls in this database's history (9), and was still playing in the 2025/26 season, over 20 years after her database debut?
questions.explanation: Jana Nell has taken 9 five-wicket hauls across 190 matches (2005 to 2026), second only to Susan Benade's 11.

questions.question: Who has achieved the fifty and 4 wickets in a match double more times, Gezelle Jansen van Rensburg or Lizelle Lee?
questions.explanation: Gezelle Jansen van Rensburg: 1 times. Lizelle Lee: 4 times.

questions.question: At which ground did Tumi Sekhukhune record their career-best bowling figures (4-20, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Wanderers, against Cobras on 2023/04/02.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Most 50+ Scores' in the 24/25 season (List A)?
questions.explanation: Robyn Dormehl holds it, with a total of 4.

questions.question: How many 50+ scores separate the all-time #1 (Yolandi van der Westhuizen) and #2 (Susan Benade) half-century makers (List A) in the 10/11 season?
questions.explanation: Yolandi van der Westhuizen: 5 — Susan Benade: 4 — a gap of 1.
